scoring_justification: The checker compares the agent's reported gamma_squared to the paper's own computed values, which act as a deterministic recomputation from the same SOEC/TOEC constants and standard formulas; no lower-level raw artifact exists for an independent recomputation in the verifier.

hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are factual values reported in the paper; they serve as the authoritative reproduction target.
